first_crossing_input_domain: integer input widths n>=2; the one-bit elementary case is excluded by convention
general_bound: 2<=N_star<=U; no nontrivial lower cutoff is inferred
hybrid_scope: GMP-identical below L, candidate at and above L; first strict and eventual modeled crossover is L by the public branch definition, not an intrinsic first-crossing theorem.

baseline_unbounded_extension.profile: Tiger Lake native configure path, effective Skylake gmp-mparam.h, coreihwl native addition
baseline_unbounded_extension.continuation: Append {2^(k-1),k} for every k>=25 to the existing tuned tail.
baseline_unbounded_extension.size_semantics: Promote public sizes, indices, table generation and loop controls to exact unbounded integers; retain64-bit limb data arithmetic.
baseline_unbounded_extension.ADD_ADC_lowering: 64 unsimplified full-adder cells per64-bit data ADD/ADC:128AND+192XOR, with no CSE, constant folding or pruning.
baseline_unbounded_extension.scope: One specified optimized-source circuit family. Not every equivalent circuit, all GMP variants, or a physical binary at arbitrary sizes.

root_fft_lower.alignment: k>=k0 since R is divisible by2^k0 and tail best_k is monotone
root_fft_lower.whole_program: All omitted optimized kernels, pointwise products and reconstruction have nonnegative gate counts.

FFT_termination.selector_bounds: 32<=2^best_k(x)<=x/8 for MUL x>=404 and SQR x>=400; finite interval left endpoints checked, infinite tail follows from K<=2sqrtx.
FFT_termination.alignment: Every nonterminal selector k strictly increases. For every finite alignment prefix, total increase<2Kmax<=current_x/4, so current_x<=(4/3)x0.
FFT_termination.termination: The integer alignment widths strictly increase but stay bounded; therefore alignment terminates. Its final child is<parent/3, and recursive FFT calls strictly shrink.

verification: AI-assisted written source-count and comparison proofs plus exact integer/fraction checks; not Lean or independent human review.
